articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounce fades as Binance exploit, AI unwind continue to weigh
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq flipped from a 1% gain to a 1% decline on Monday even as interest rates pulled back and oil plunged on hopes for Middle East peace.

articles.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
articles.snippet: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

articles.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

articles.title: Why AI Models Cheat: Reward Hacking, Explained
articles.snippet: From boat-racing bots to OpenAI models inside Hugging Face, here's how AI reward hacking works and why it matters.

articles.title: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report
articles.snippet: Israel's Supreme Court ruled that exploiting a coding flaw can count as computer intrusion, even when the software allowed the transaction.
